item.kultivator.token_darah_api.tooltip: Key to the Vale of the Trial by Blood and Fire (Qi Refining and Foundation only). Consumed on a clear, kept when expelled.
item.kultivator.token_darah_api.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 155–160 (the Trial by Blood and Fire bars Foundation Establishment and up)
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_fragment.tool: Join three into a Heavenvoid Hall Map.
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_fragment.sour: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 1129 (no one enters the Heavenvoid Hall without a map fragment)
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_map.tooltip: Key to the Heavenvoid Hall (Golden Core to Dao Union). Consumed on a clear.
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_map.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 1129
item.kultivator.cold_ice_pearl.tooltip: In the off hand: the Lava Road burns half as much and entity fire lasts half as long.
item.kultivator.cold_ice_pearl.inspired: Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, the Heavenvoid Hall arc: Man Huzi's Cold Ice Pearl (寒冰珠) on the lava road (熔岩路)
item.kultivator.soul_nurturing_wood.tool: A weapon-spirit seed, the core of a Supreme Spatial Ring and an alternative Soul Nurturing recipe.
item.kultivator.soul_nurturing_wood.insp: Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Soul Nurturing Wood, one of the Three Divine Woods that keep a soul from scattering
item.kultivator.inheritance_crystal.tool: Key to the Land of the Ancient God (Deity Transformation and up). Consumed on a clear, kept when expelled.
item.kultivator.inheritance_crystal.sour: Source: Renegade Immortal, ch. 198 (an ice crystal melts and fuses with Wang Lin's soul)
item.kultivator.ancient_god_blood.toolti: Material for Abadi forging and refinement +7 to +9.
item.kultivator.ancient_god_blood.inspir: Inspired by Renegade Immortal, ch. 198–199 (the body is reconstructed again and again)
item.kultivator.tomb_sigil.tooltip: Key to the Heavenly Tomb (Immortal Ascension and up). One is spent per descent of up to 3 layers.
item.kultivator.tomb_sigil.source: Source: game design (the key), set in Battle Through the Heavens, ch. 1352
item.kultivator.tomb_essence.tooltip: Material for Dewa forging, refinement +10 to +12 and cheaper star condensing.
item.kultivator.tomb_essence.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens, ch. 1352 (the Tomb's energy may come, in part, from Ancient Devouring Insects) and ch. 1600 (its energy bodies tremble under great pressure)
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_cauldron.tool: Its lid will not open. A great forger might yet lift it at an Earthfire Forge.
item.kultivator.heavenvoid_cauldron.sour: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 480 (the famous cauldron, a blue flame at the bottom of a deep hole) and ch. 499 (its lid would not open in the slightest)
kultivator.alam.item.key_use: Use it on open ground to open the realm's gate.
kultivator.alam.realm.blood_fire_trial: Vale of the Trial by Blood and Fire
kultivator.alam.realm.blood_fire_trial.s: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 155–160 (ch. 160: the herb ground is incomparably dangerous; per the fan wiki, Foundation Establishment and above are barred and fewer than a third survive). "Vale" names the player's instance.
kultivator.alam.realm.blood_fire_trial.r: First clear: 4 Foundation Herbs, 4 Low stones and a golden page (a jade slip). Repeat: 1 herb, 2 Low stones.
kultivator.alam.realm.heavenvoid_hall.so: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 1126 (maze paths, illusions broken by Brightsight Spirit Eyes, stone gates where no treasure was found) and ch. 1129 (the hall opens again, a map fragment is needed).
kultivator.alam.realm.heavenvoid_hall.re: First clear: the Heavenvoid Cauldron, 2 Soul Nurturing Wood, 2 Mid stones, a High core. Every clear: choose 1 of 3.
kultivator.alam.realm.ancient_god_land.s: Source: Renegade Immortal, ch. 187–199 (ch. 198: 94 ice crystals, a crystal melts into Wang Lin's soul; ch. 199: after the 70th crystal each took several times longer). The permanent health is game design.
kultivator.alam.realm.ancient_god_land.r: Per crystal: +0.25 max health for good (up to 94). Per hall: 1 Ancient God Blood.
kultivator.alam.realm.heavenly_tomb.sour: Source: Battle Through the Heavens, ch. 1352 and 1600 (the Tomb's energy and its trembling energy bodies). Layers, endless depth and sigils are game design.
kultivator.alam.realm.heavenly_tomb.rewa: Per layer: Tomb Energy Essence. New best on layer 9, 18, 27…: a Supreme stone, a Raja core, a sigil and a choice.
kultivator.alam.chamber.battle.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 160, per the fan wiki (fewer than a third survive)
kultivator.alam.chamber.lava_road.source: Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, the Heavenvoid Hall arc: the lava road (熔岩路), the Cold Ice Pearl (寒冰珠) and the Fire-Avoiding Treasure Robe (辟火宝衣)

kultivator.alam.chamber.ant_field.source: Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Ironfire Ants (铁火蚁) live in hot lava terrain
kultivator.alam.chamber.illusion_maze.so: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 1126 (maze-like paths, illusions broken by Brightsight Spirit Eyes)
kultivator.alam.chamber.stone_gates.sour: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, ch. 1126 (stone gates onto treasure rooms where no treasure was found)
kultivator.alam.chamber.energy_bodies.so: Source: Battle Through the Heavens, ch. 1352, 1600

kultivator.screen.help.alam_rahasia: Use a realm key on open ground (or Scroll › World › Realms) to open a gate: a 10 s omen, then you, up to 3 sect mates who click [Masuk] and up to 2 of your Murid Dalam+ enter a private stage of the kultivator:alam_rahasia dimension. Chambers come one after another; when one is cleared, step onto the glyph pad. A guardian waits at the end, then the Treasure Scroll. A lethal hit inside expels you at 1 HP with Luka Alam (techniques ×0.8 for 5 minutes); totems are not spent. Four realms: Vale of Blood and Fire (Qi Refining–Foundation, token from dungeon chests), Heavenvoid Hall (Golden Core–Dao Union, map of 3 fragments), Land of the Ancient God (Deity Transformation+, +0.25 max health per crystal) and the endless Heavenly Tomb (Immortal Ascension+). No block is ever changed; with Mode Ringan the realm is projected around you instead. /kultivasi alam daftar lists them.
